integrity: The all-length formulas follow from an explicit characterization of realizable adjacent-pair count quadruples and run-composition counting. Exhaustive enumeration through length 16 and an arithmetic profile check through length 200 are corroborative, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific limitations: Binary alphabet and exact read length two only; no claim for larger alphabets, larger read lengths, noisy or incomplete spectra, cyclic spectra, or efficient ranking/unranking of an optimal representative codebook.
title: Exact binary two-multispectrum code size and singleton classification
